extracted.summary: A scholarship for Scheduled Caste students pursuing undergraduate or postgraduate studies, providing financial assistance for tuition and living expenses.
extracted.amount_text: Full tuition fee and non-refundable charges. A ceiling of INR 2,00,000 per annum per student applies to private sector institutions. Academic allowance for the first year: INR 86,000. Academic allowance for subsequent years: INR 41,000 per year.
extracted.min_percentage_quote: Applicants must have passed the Class 12 examination with a minimum of 60% marks.
extracted.max_family_income_quote: Applicants must have an annual income of less than INR 8,00,000 from all sources.
extracted.categories_quote: Applicants must belong to the Scheduled Caste (SC) category.
extracted.course_levels_quote: Applicants must have secured admission to a recognised college or university for a full-time undergraduate or postgraduate degree.
